headline: Technocraft Ventures files AGM voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Technocraft Ventures has submitted the consolidated Scrutinizer's report and voting results for its 28th Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate compliance measure following the conclusion of shareholder voting. Such procedural disclosures do not impact the company's financial position or business operations. For retail shareholders, this filing completes the mandatory post-AGM regulatory formalities.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price
